children: According to Wallstreetcn, Anderson Institute economist and former deputy director of the Federal Reserve's monetary affairs division James Clouse said the market seemed to interpret it as hawkish, which he considered reasonable, but that Powell was only saying there was still work to do and did not really address timing.

title: James Clouse: Markets Read It as Hawkish, and That Is Reasonable
